name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying Human Resources in São Paulo, he volunteered at the Interlagos circuit during the Brazilian Grand Prix. The energy and passion ignited a desire to combine his professional skills with his newfound love for racing. After graduating, he sought opportunities within smaller racing teams, quickly gaining experience in recruitment, team management, and employee relations. He is known for his commitment to building strong team dynamics and fostering a positive work environment.

Rafael believes that a happy and motivated team is crucial for success on and off the track. He's a strong advocate for fair treatment, professional development, and open communication. His dedication to his team and his proactive approach to HR challenges make him an invaluable asset. He joined Iron Dames eager to contribute to their inspiring mission and help them reach new heights.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a thermos of mate tea on his desk.
Uses racing analogies in everyday conversations.
Keeps a small, framed photo of Ayrton Senna on his desk for inspiration.
